definitions.explanation: Expensive relative to what you get, or more expensive compared to alternatives. Implies the price is higher than expected or than what seems fair for the value.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割高|わりだか}だ。
⟦コンビニ→コンビニ：01081_konbini⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{割高|わりだか}だ⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores are pricier, but they're convenient.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少量|しょうりょう}→少量：12436_shouryou⟧⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大容量|だいようりょう}→大容量：19805_daiyouryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{比|くら}べて→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{割高|わりだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Smaller packages tend to be relatively more expensive compared to bulk sizes.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{割安|わりやす}→割安：14735_wariyasu⟧ (relatively cheap / good value). Both use ⟦{割|わり}→割：03194_wari⟧ (ratio, proportion) to express price relative to value or compared to alternatives.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {割高|わりだか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel overpriced)
- {割高|わりだか}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧ (relatively expensive product)
- ⟦ちょっと→ちょっと：00595_chotto⟧{割高|わりだか} (a bit pricey)

Can be used as a noun or na-adjective: {割高|わりだか}だ / {割高|わりだか}な⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧.
